title: Cyclotomic Perfect-Power Theorem
reduction_formula: 4 Phi3(q)-3=(2q+1)^2 and 4 Phi6(q)-3=(2q-1)^2, reducing perfect powers to x^2+3=4y^n
classical_input: Ljunggren theorem: the only nontrivial positive solution of x^2+3=4y^n with y>1, n>1 is (37,7,3)
theorem_summary: For q>=3 and n>1, the only nontrivial perfect-power values of Phi3(q)=q^2+q+1 and Phi6(q)=q^2-q+1 are Phi3(18)=7^3 and Phi6(19)=7^3.
